settings.custom_subtitle: If you love your floors, why not share them?
settings.custom_description:
When you refer a friend, they’ll get 5% off their flooring order plus free freight shipping*. To thank you, we’ll send you a $200 Visa Gift Card*.

Now, you can help others lay the foundation for their own unforgettable spaces. Simply share your contact details along with your friend's, and we'll share the rewards!

settings.usp_content: Click below to share your contact info as well as your friend’s. We’ll be notified and will get in touch.
*When your friends and family make a flooring purchase of 500 SF or more, they will receive 5% off and free freight shipping.
When someone you refer makes a purchase, we’ll send you a $200 Visa Gift Card. It’s a win-win!

settings.rich_text: *A minimum flooring purchase of 500 sqft is required to qualify for a Visa gift card referral reward.
